heroHeadline: Day 776: One-Year-Old Boy Among Three Killed in Prados del Sur Attack; Four Separate Gun Killings Hit Culiacán Sep 3–5
heroSubtitle: 776 days of cartel civil war: gunmen opened fire on a group gathered outside a home in Culiacán's Prados del Sur neighborhood on the night of September 5, killing one-year-and-four-month-old Juan Alejandro and an adult, Jesús Manuel, and wounding two others — a suspected attacker was shot by his own companions during the attack and died the next morning. Hours earlier the same evening, gunmen killed a 27-year-old man at a beer store in the city's Las Estancias sector. The attacks followed a bloody September 3, when two men were shot dead inside a car wash in the Los Ángeles sector and a third man was executed on the La Costerita bypass south of the city. The child's death adds to an estimated 250 minors killed by gunfire in Sinaloa since the Chapitos–Mayos conflict erupted in September 2024, with no sign of the daily toll in Culiacán easing.
